stage: CUBE-REV 0.10.5-R1.8 — Prospective Primitive-detour Holdout, Algorithm-aware Null Court & Phase-boundary Subgoal-distance Recovery Test
intent: Test whether route-level progress reversals relative to annotation-certified phase boundaries contain signal beyond notation compression, commuting-face normalization, representation identities, and ordinary algorithmic non-monotonicity. Preserve R1.7's failure boundary rather than redefining local move equivalence until positives appear.
napkin_invariants: R1.7 R5 zero is a failure-boundary result for one exact-local noncommuting-primitive definition, not evidence that human detours or recovery do not exist.
R1.8 must not restore R1.7 algebraic, multi-generator, or minimal-irreducible positives as cognitive-recovery prevalence.

Holdout membership is selected without route/subgoal outcomes and must be disjoint at the official-attempt key (result_id, attempt_number) from the R1.7 900-attempt route sample whenever the source vintage permits it.
If a speed×era cell has no untouched linked attempts, that cell is non-holdout-identifiable in the frozen vintage and cannot be silently represented by reused R1.7 attempts.

Modern 2023–26 × 7–10 s is explicitly known to have been exhausted 100/100 by the R1.7 route sample in the frozen R1.6 analytical vintage. A same-vintage holdout may not claim independent replication for this cell.

A fresh reconstruction vintage may repair the modern-cell holdout only with records demonstrably absent from the R1.6/R1.7 source universe; otherwise the modern replication gate remains HOLD_FRESH_MODERN_CELL.
The WCA Results Export remains an outcome/solver/competition/era spine. It is not an attempt-level scramble identity source.
Raw alg.cubing.net setup+alg is the route-state source; route admission requires parser success plus cubing.js KPattern solved-state certification.
Annotation labels segment phases but do not by themselves prove cognitive subgoals. Every phase-distance computation must be state-derived.
Distance reversal is called excursion/reversal, not recovery, until it exceeds the frozen algorithm-aware null and survives representation/commutation controls.
No result-dependent change to distance metric, excursion threshold, null family, phase eligibility, target population, or holdout membership is allowed. Any such change is a new version/remand.
No human observation, recruitment, main-branch deployment, or public-runner write occurs in R1.8.

prospective_data_design.calibration_only: R1.7 900-attempt SHA-stratified sample and all R1.7 R2–R5 outcomes.
prospective_data_design.holdout_A: Frozen-vintage attempt-disjoint holdout drawn only from canonical linked <10 s attempts not present in the R1.7 900 sample; claim scope restricted to speed×era cells with untouched support.
prospective_data_design.holdout_B: Fresh-vintage modern-cell replication, admitted only for reconstruction records and official-attempt keys absent from the frozen R1.6/R1.7 universe. If insufficient, report HOLD_FRESH_MODERN_CELL without substituting reused records.
prospective_data_design.selection_key: SHA-256 deterministic rank from immutable official-attempt key and R1.8 salt; never phase outcome or reconstruction quality.

phase_distance_definition.unit: one annotation-certified non-inspection phase line in one state-certified reconstruction
phase_distance_definition.boundary_target: the exact cube KPattern reached at the end of that annotation line
phase_distance_definition.state_sequence: KPattern after each expanded leaf move from the line start through the line end
phase_distance_definition.primary_distance: orbit-normalized cubie disagreement to the phase-boundary target: 0.5*(edge piece+orientation mismatches/12) + 0.5*(corner piece+orientation mismatches/8); centers excluded and whole-cube orientation normalized by evaluating the minimum over the 24 physical cube orientations
phase_distance_definition.secondary_distance: unweighted total edge+corner piece+orientation mismatch count to the phase-boundary target, orientation-normalized over the same 24 cube orientations
phase_distance_definition.progress_frontier: running minimum of primary_distance from line start
phase_distance_definition.recovery_depth: for an excursion peak, decrease from the peak to the best later primary_distance before the phase endpoint
phase_distance_definition.candidate_reversal: excursion_amplitude >= 1/24 and recovery_depth >= excursion_amplitude; the 1/24 floor corresponds to one half-weight edge mismatch quantum and is frozen before holdout outcome inspection
phase_distance_definition.phase_boundary_completion: the endpoint itself is not counted as evidence of recovery; candidate scoring requires the return below the pre-excursion frontier strictly before the final phase move, preventing every nonmonotone line from becoming a trivial recovery because the endpoint distance is zero

algorithm_aware_null.purpose: Estimate how often ordinary correct algorithm execution is non-monotone with respect to the same phase-boundary distance, so generic algorithm geometry is not mislabeled recovery.
families: observed-clean calibration segments from R1.7 that are state-certified and contain no R5 noncommuting-primitive positive (R5 had 0/874, so this family estimates ordinary observed algorithm geometry without asserting cognitive cleanliness)

same-transformation solver null: solve the phase segment's relative transformation back to identity with a pinned 3×3 solver and invert the returned solve to obtain an alternative algorithm realizing the identical start→boundary transformation

representation null: commute opposite faces, normalize rotations/wide/slice representations where transformation identity is preserved, and recompute the distance path to quantify notation-induced excursion
algorithm_aware_null.primary_null_threshold: method×phase-specific 99th percentile of excursion_amplitude when >=40 calibration segments exist; otherwise method-agnostic phase 99th percentile when >=80; otherwise global 99.5th percentile. Threshold selection hierarchy is frozen before holdout.
algorithm_aware_null.algorithm_excess_candidate: holdout candidate_reversal whose excursion_amplitude is strictly above its frozen null threshold and whose pre-endpoint recovery occurs before the final phase move
algorithm_aware_null.null_claim_boundary: Null exceedance is a state-trajectory anomaly relative to the modeled algorithm families, not proof of error, intention, awareness, or recovery mechanism.

primitive_detour_replication.definition: Exact R1.7 R5 noncommuting-primitive definition is copied without alteration: ordinary outer-face turns only; at least one non-opposite generator pair; no proper contiguous subinterval with any detected exact shortening/identity relation; full-route endpoint preserved.
primitive_detour_replication.role: prospective falsification control on untouched holdout routes
primitive_detour_replication.frozen_expectation: R1.7 observed 0/874; R1.8 reports the untouched holdout count and confidence bound without changing the definition if positives occur.

predeclared_outcomes.primary: attempt-level indicator of >=1 algorithm-excess phase excursion in holdout_A, standardized only over the untouched-support target if weight gates pass
secondary: phase-line algorithm-excess excursion rate with cluster bootstrap by official attempt
distribution of excursion_amplitude minus frozen null threshold
robustness: exclude any line containing UNKNOWN or AMBIGUOUS phase label
method-specific descriptive results are reconstruction-frame only unless a population method spine exists
sub-7 target only if its own route-sample ESS >= 200

falsifiers: Known solved fixtures fail the phase-distance orientation normalization.
Distance differs under physically equivalent whole-cube orientations after normalization.
Ordinary algorithm null produces excursion rates so high that the frozen threshold has no discriminatory support.
Holdout_A has <500 state-certified routes or standardized target coverage <0.90.
Weight ESS <200 or stabilized weights exceed p99=10/max=20 for a proposed standardized claim.
Any holdout attempt key overlaps the R1.7 900-sample key set.
A fresh-vintage record cannot be proven absent from the frozen source universe.
Any analysis script reads holdout excursion outcomes before null thresholds are sealed.

allowed_if_gates_pass: Prospective state-trajectory excursion rate relative to frozen phase-boundary and algorithm-null definitions in an explicitly supported untouched linked-reconstruction target.
Prospective replication or non-replication of the unchanged R1.7 R5 primitive-detour definition.
Method/phase reconstruction-frame descriptive comparisons with explicit scope.
prohibited: Independent modern 7–10 s replication from reused R1.7 attempts.
Treating annotation labels as ground-truth latent cognitive states.
